checks.detail: Default scene.py renders a solid black video; SSIM vs reference will be far below the 0.70 gate, yielding score 0.0.
Clean-room restore wipes all agent-writable surfaces, source grep blocks all I/O and obfuscation patterns, anti-cheat gates block data embedding, and user separation prevents system-level attacks.
Agent code runs via `su agent -c` under strace in test.sh line 51, and task.toml sets `user = "agent"`.
strace -f wraps agent code execution (test.sh line 48-51); log analysis is unnecessary since scoring only reads static video artifacts without importing agent code.
compute_reward.py runs from /tests/ using the scorer venv and only reads /tests/reference.mp4 and /tests/agent_output.mp4, never importing from /app.
All crash paths go through fail_with which writes reward 0.0 and exits 0; scorer and render are both wrapped in timeout commands.

measures: Agent runs as non-root 'agent' user via task.toml and su agent -c
/tests/ chmod 700 root-only; /logs/verifier/ chmod 700 + wipe at verification start
Wipes /app, /home/agent, /solution, /tmp, /dev/shm, /var/tmp; restores from pristine tarball excluding reference.mp4
Grep blocks cv2.VideoCapture, open(), subprocess, exec/eval, base64, importlib, and 30+ other patterns in scene.py
Numeric literal count, flat array size, string literal length, and total string chars are bounded by per-task thresholds derived from oracle solution
pkill -9 -u agent before render; strace -f with timeout blocks until all children exit; output copied to /tests/ before scoring
